title: 1991 AHSME Problem 4
statement: Which of the following triangles cannot exist?

solutions.text:
A right triangle has one \(90^\circ\) angle, leaving only \(90^\circ\) for its other two positive angles together. Neither remaining angle can therefore be obtuse. Hence a triangle cannot be both right and obtuse.

Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: A right triangle already contains an angle of \(90^\circ\)
An obtuse triangle must contain an angle greater than \(90^\circ\)
